cover_letter:
Dear Kimia and the CurveCatch team,

I'm writing to apply for the Marketing All-rounder / Growth Marketer position. CurveCatch's journey from a personal home-try-on service to a data layer for lingerie brands is exactly the kind of builder story that excites me. I'm a digital marketer with a technical background, working where SEO, content and web meet. I build and optimize websites for traditional and AI-powered search, write content that ranks, and use AI tools and code to automate the repetitive work.

In my current role at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console. I also manage CMS content in WordPress, ensuring pages and blog posts are current. Beyond that, I've built and optimized websites like mirook.com, where I implemented JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup and an llms.txt file, and ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. My freelance work on baverok.com involved designing and building the site myself, including a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero and structured data.

What draws me to CurveCatch is the emphasis on building systems and automations to avoid bottlenecks. I use LLMs daily for research, content and audits, and I've integrated MCP into WordPress and SEO tools. I also have experience with Python automation and have developed an Android app live on Google Play. This technical foundation means I can configure automations myself and think like an engineer—structured and systems-first.

I'm proactive and comfortable owning KPIs. I prioritize like a pro, always focusing on the most impactful fires. I'm a hands-on builder at core, eager to execute first to understand the work before automating or outsourcing. I'm excited about the opportunity to take growth over from Kimia and work closely with her, and to help CurveCatch conquer Europe.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your mission.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Digital marketer with technical background, specializing in SEO, GEO, content, and web, with a focus on AI-powered search and automation.
• Current Junior Digital Marketer at Episto: handles on-page SEO, keyword research, SEO content, and CMS management in WordPress for client websites.
• Freelance experience building and optimizing websites (baverok.com, mirook.com) with structured data, technical SEO/GEO audits, and measurable improvements in search health.
• Proficient in AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) for research, content, and audits; uses Python automation and has developed an Android app live on Google Play.
• Strong analytical skills with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Ads; certified in SEO Fundamentals and SEO Toolkit from Semrush Academy.
